build_CEMPlannerNetwork: build a CEMPlannerNetwork with an ensemble of MemoryNetwork world models for cross entropy method planning
run_CEMPlannerNetwork_forward: run the CEMPlannerNetwork forward pass to plan the best next action from a given state
test_continuous_planning: test the continuous_planning method to search optimal continuous actions using CEM iterations and elite selection
test_discrete_planning: test the discrete_planning method to find the best discrete action via random shooting over action sequences
review_sample_reward_next_state_terminal: review the sample_reward_next_state_terminal method to sample one-step dynamics from a world model using mixture distributions
